# Sample corpus provenance

The files under `testdata/corpus/` are **original sample excerpts** written for SNIP Phase 1A.

They are **not** copies of 3GPP technical specifications. They are short, fictional planning-guidance notes that use public radio-planning vocabulary (BLER, mid-band, interference) so retrieval and citation can be tested without ingesting copyrighted specifications.

Do not scrape 3GPP.org. Do not replace this corpus with full copyrighted specs unless document rights are confirmed and this file is updated.

The Phase 1B network inventory (sites, gNBs, cells, KPIs, neighbours) is **synthetic demo seed** loaded by Flyway (`V2__seed_demo_network.sql`). It is not live OSS/NMS/EMS data.
